factProposals.value: A booking is confirmed only when name, email and phone pass format checks; otherwise it is rejected with the failed fields named.
The audit log stores only the request id, time, outcome and failed field names, never the email or phone.

decisions.statement: Contact verification is a local format check; no external verification service is called.
decisions.rationale: The story names no external service, and none was available to test against.

decisions.statement: Bookings, verification and audit entries are idempotent on a client-supplied requestId, and a failed or timed-out verifier blocks the booking.
decisions.rationale: Repeated submits and network errors must not double-book or confirm unverified contacts.

limitations.statement: Bookings are held in memory only and are lost on restart; only the audit log is persisted.
Verification checks format only; it cannot tell whether an email address or phone number actually belongs to the customer.
